gate.approval: MarketPolicyApproval with explicit owner, approvedAt, public policy version/hash, taxonomy revision, retention <=90 days and suppression threshold >=5 distinct subjects
gate.default: undefined service; no collection or network request

runtimeIntegration.creation: runtime.ts constructs insights only when SITE_MARKET_INSIGHTS_ENABLED=1 plus matching SITE_MARKET_POLICY_SHA256 and privately configured SITE_MARKET_POLICY_APPROVAL_JSON are valid. No flag is enabled in live environments.
runtimeIntegration.atomicSources: Visitor events share SessionState state/receipt CAS. Human delivered/assigned events share the encrypted inbox packet and observation CAS; this remains durable after the 7-day visitor session expires.
runtimeIntegration.staff: site-team-api invokes marketTeamRequest only after real IAM-backed staff cookie authentication, persistent quota and origin checks, with explicit mode STAFF.
runtimeIntegration.staffLink: /api/site/team/metrics/; link is hidden when instrumentation is disabled.
runtimeIntegration.reviewLink: Authenticated team detail links the opaque subject to its review portal.
runtimeIntegration.retention: standalone bounded retention invokes metrics cleanup only when the approved feature is configured. Maximum event/review/exclusion retention is 90 days.
runtimeIntegration.worker: Separate 30-second Node timer; default three events/cycle, durable CAS lease, receiver deduplication, maximum eight attempts, bounded backoff and Retry-After circuit breaker. No provider body or conversation is logged.
runtimeIntegration.defaultOff: No analytics producer, collector query or worker timer is started without the approved enabled configuration.

producerRequirements.name: concept.ready

producerRequirements.name: concept.failed
producerRequirements.proof: Failed or expired job committed; jobRef and failure timestamp; no raw provider error.

producerRequirements.name: concept.refined

producerRequirements.name: human.assigned
producerRequirements.proof: Authenticated operator actually claims request; stable observed event ID/time.
